title: Field3 Log Owner Join
objective: Authenticate batched field-3 real and complex logarithm owners and fail-atomically join source-order columns into the packed 3x301 raw logarithm owner without inventing missing complex columns

oracles: qualified real 0:28 owner, qualified 32-selected-column complex prefix, exact source/norm replay, exact scalar identities, synthetic protocol fixtures

handoff.summary: Added a strict source-transparent coordinator for the eventual authoritative real and complex field-3 logarithm owners. It authenticates immutable content-addressed owners, independently replays all 301 exact determinant-norm consequences from the frozen sources, checks scalar identities, preserves producer cells without reassociation, and atomically publishes the 6321-cell raw 3x301 owner only after complete validation. The qualified partial corpus and synthetic full-protocol mutations exercise the boundary without fabricating or publishing missing mathematical data.
risks: The complete authoritative complex owner did not yet exist, so the complete-path test uses structural synthetic cells only; they are not mathematical evidence and are never published outside a temporary directory.
The first real-data complete join still depends on recording the exact byte hashes of the eventual complete real and complex owners.
The lane remains active rather than review because the coordinator explicitly requested no heavy build; the lane-required baselib/native suites were not run.
next_steps: After the complex corpus lane publishes all 301 columns, run this coordinator with independently recorded real/complex owner hashes and preserve the resulting immutable raw-log owner identity.
Use the authenticated raw 3x301 owner as the only C1 input to the retained 301x13 transform and subsequent regulator/LLL/cleanarch/getfu stages.
